articles.title: Christa Pike 'angry and confused' after failed execution, lawyers say
articles.description: Lawyers say the convicted killer was surprised to have survived and remained "shackled" to her hospital bed.

articles.title: Watch: What we know about Christa Pike's ‘shock’ recovery in hospital
articles.description: The US death row inmate's legal team said at a press conference that she is now "conscious and speaking" after her failed execution.

articles.title: Burnham to hold security talks with German chancellor in Berlin
articles.description: Downing Street said deeper co-operation in the face of rising hybrid threats from Russia would be high on the agenda during Burnham's first official visit to Germany.

articles.title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies, union says
articles.description: Maricarmen Abascal, 87, was forcibly removed on a stretcher from her apartment of more than 70 years in September.
